description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendments: Pothupitiya, Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530016
categorisation: This gazette exclusively contains amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It deals with specific corrections and updates to land parcel records, including changes to land extent measurements, ownership details, mortgage information, and servitude rights. The content is entirely focused on land and property-related administrative matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification.
